title: Quick Sort
summary: Partition around a pivot so smaller elements go left, larger go right; recurse.
usage: Fast in-place average O(n log n). Most-used general sort. Worst case O(n^2).
pythonSource:
def quick_sort(a, lo, hi):
    if lo >= hi: return
    p = partition(a, lo, hi)
    quick_sort(a, lo, p-1); quick_sort(a, p+1, hi)

steps.title: Partition
steps.explanation: All values > 1, so pivot moves to the front.
